fields.description: Issue features editorials and reporting on Dade County grand jury matters and criticism of Circuit Judge Stanley Milledge, including discussion of alleged graft and the role of Miami’s daily newspapers. Coverage includes police and gambling enforcement, municipal politics at City Hall, and debate over Florida Power & Light rate-setting and recall provisions. Additional content includes local court/divorce filings, public-safety incidents, and extensive nightlife/entertainment and business directory listings.
